```plato

// A shadow cast by filled geometry: offset in the geometry's space, Gaussian
// blur radius, spread (outset applied before blurring; negative insets), and
// color including alpha. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drop_shadow)
type ShadowStyle2D
    implements IValue
{
    Offset: Vector2D;
    BlurRadius: Number;
    Spread: Number;
    Color: Color;
}
```
